question: What product did Norstella launch in August 2026?

hits.title: Norstella launches Atlas, an agentic AI platform built on biopharma's most connected data.
hits.snippet: NEW YORK, Aug. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ - Norstella, the connected data foundation the life sciences industry relies on, today launched Norstella Atlas, an agentic AI platform that turns that foundation into finished, decision-ready work.

hits.title: Recursion expands strategic partnership with Citeline to advance its ai-enabled ClinTech platform.
hits.snippet: "Recursion has been an exceptional partner to Norstella [Citeline's parent company] and Citeline, consistently pushing the boundaries of what's possible at the intersection of biology, technology, and data," said Fred Hassan, Norstella Executive Chair.

hits.title: Healthcare Leader Fred Hassan Appointed Executive Chair of Norstella
hits.snippet: Norstella, a leading global provider of pharma intelligence solutions, announced today that healthcare industry leader Fred Hassan has been appointed Executive Chair.

hits.title: Norstella Appoints Kris Joshi as Chief Executive Officer
hits.snippet: Norstella, a leading global provider of pharma intelligence solutions, has appointed health-tech leader Kris Joshi as the company's new CEO.

hits.title: Norstella's Ethan Smith on trends at ASCO 2025
hits.snippet: Norstella's ethan Smith on trends at ASCO 2025.

hits.title: Norstella Named to Fast Company's Annual List of the World's Most Innovative Companies of 2025
hits.snippet: NEW YORK, March 18, 2025 /PRNewswire-PRWeb/ - Norstella, a leading global provider of pharma intelligence solutions, is proud to have been named to Fast Company's prestigious list of the World's Most Innovative Companies of 2025.

hits.title: Norstella introduces NorstellaLinQ, the biopharma industry's first fully integrated data asset.
hits.snippet: NEW YORK - October 8, 2024 - Today, Norstella unveiled NorstellaLinQ, the biopharma industry's first and only fully integrated data asset combining both real-world data (RWD) - including open and closed claims, lab results and structured and unstructured electronic medical records (EMR) - with Norstella's proprietary forecasting, clinical, regulatory, payer, coverage and commercial intelligence data.

hits.title: Atropos Health Partners with Norstella to Expand the Atropos Evidence(TM) Network and Structured Clinical Trial Intelligence
hits.snippet: Norstella, one of the largest global pharma intelligence solution providers, today announced a strategic partnership with Atropos Health, the pioneer in translating real-world clinical data into high-quality personalized real-world evidence for care.

hits.title: Evaluate wins Best Decision Management Solution at 2023 AI Breakthrough Awards
hits.snippet: Evaluate, a Norstella company, today announced that its Evaluate Omnium intelligent forecasting solution has been selected as winner of the ‘Best Decision Management Solution’ award in the sixth annual AI Breakthrough Awards programme conducted by AI Breakthrough, a leading market intelligence organisation that recognises the top companies, technologies and products in the global Artificial Intelligence (AI) market today.

hits.title: Norstella completes merger with Citeline to form $5B pharma intelligence group
hits.snippet: (cagkansayin/GettyImages) Norstella completed its acquisition of clinical trial intelligence specialist Citeline as part of the pharma solutions group’s goal to become a global leader in end-to-end consultancy services for the industry.

extract.answer: Norstella Atlas, an agentic AI platform.
